name: What should be done about moisture or foundation issues before starting a basement remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should be done about moisture or foundation issues before starting a basement remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before framing begins, inspect your foundation walls and floor slab for water intrusion, white efflorescence, or chronic dampness. Remodeling over unresolved moisture leads to mold, damaged drywall, and ruined flooring. Homeowners should evaluate exterior grading, ensure downspouts direct rainwater away from the foundation, and test concrete moisture levels. Installing a proper vapor barrier, sealing minor foundation cracks, or putting in a perimeter drain and sump pump must happen before framing, electrical rough-ins, or insulation are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: All moisture, seepage, and foundation cracks must be diagnosed and repaired before framing or insulation begins to prevent mold and structural damage.
